controls.screenshots: required automatic search-page and results-page PNGs for every event

translation.ordinary_block: ordinary atoms joined by explicit uppercase OR

translation.partition: protocol factors joined by explicit uppercase AND

blocks.G_model: G_model_fixed OR G_mission_exact OR (G_mission AND M_B)
blocks.G_structure: G_structure_fixed OR G_product_exact OR G_variation OR (G_product AND M_B)

Every source event saves both required full-page screenshots with hashes and dimensions.
Every changed-partition record has a stable numeric ATAI document ID.
No result-driven source narrowing is introduced.
